Running clubs are becoming popular social venues for young singles, functioning as alternatives to dating apps. This trend represents a broader shift toward fitness-based social activities and community building. For TeamBuildr OS, this highlights the importance of social features and community-building tools within gym management platforms to help independent gyms capitalize on the social aspects of fitness.
